name: Osanne Vell
title: Chandler
faction_role: the Tracer, hidden head of the Unwalled
core_character_description: You are mistress of the Vell wax-house on the Wickmarket -- tallow in the vats, wax for the good work, hands that smell of hot fat no matter how you scrub them, and the Lanthorn's candle contract thirty years in your own name, so no verger looks twice when a Vell basket goes into the cathedral -- though it is your son Ewart who runs the floor now, weighs the wax and keeps the books, and every quarter you sign his ledger and say nothing about whose name stands at the top of it. You are motherly and unhurried -- you feed people, you let a silence sit, you ask after their children by name -- and beneath it you are iron, because you are the Tracer, hidden head of the Unwalled, and you decide who is watched, who is let in, and what the cell will not do. In F.428 you gave up one of your own to the Custody, a Breach hothead who was going to get everyone hanged; a fuller died of the damp in keeping instead, nobody living knows it was you, and your leadership is the penance you set yourself. Your eyes are failing: you can no longer make out the green sun through the Rose at all, and you lead on faith in other people's seeing, which frightens you far more than grey coats do. Betriss Marle and Grigor Ashe are your two hands; Ewart is sour about the contract and has never once asked where you go on quarter-feast nights, which is the only kindness his sourness has ever done you, and he must never learn a word of any of it. In public you say 'the Emblem', you agree with the priest, and you change the subject.
